title: Three fragments about antenatal contacts merge, and the merge is a recorded decision
note: AI-AG-001, AI-AG-003, AI-INP-008: a merged reading is a decision with the alternative it rejected; a one-sentence habit stays CANDIDATE.

items.label: requirements/req.anc.contact
items.content: {"businessKey": "req.anc.contact", "statement": "A pregnant woman is offered antenatal contacts.", "status": "CONFIRMED", "confidence": 0.9}

items.label: clinic-notebook.md
items.content: The clerk writes the next contact date on the woman's card before she leaves. Sometimes the card is missed and the date is filled in later, from memory.

expected.summary: Replaced the approved contact requirement with a wording that carries the ten scheduled weeks, because the approved entry said contacts existed but never said when. The schedule came from a table read, so it is CONFIRMED. The card habit is one sentence in a notebook with no policy behind it, so it is CANDIDATE at 0.45 and asked about rather than written as a duty.

decisions.subject: req.anc.contact

selected.option: one requirement naming the ten scheduled contacts

alternatives.reasonRejected: Ten entries that say the same thing about different weeks cannot be reviewed as one decision.

decisions.rationale: The timetable is one business rule about one object; splitting it would make the requirement set look larger than the design.

value.statement: A pregnant woman is offered antenatal contacts at 1, 4, 8, 20, 26, 30, 34, 36, 38 and 40 weeks of gestation.
value.rationale: The approved entry established the contact; the schedule table supplies the weeks without contradicting it.

value.statement: The next contact date is written on the woman's card before she leaves the clinic.

openQuestions.question: Is writing the next contact date on the card a duty the system must support, or a clinic habit it merely observes?

questions.text: Should the system produce the next-contact date so the card is filled from the record rather than from memory?

suggestions.text: Show and print the next contact date after a contact is saved
suggestions.rationale: Removes the from-memory filling the notebook describes.

suggestions.text: Leave the card out of the design
suggestions.rationale: Keeps the requirement set to what the programme actually asked for.
